snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_ADDITIONAL_TREEHOUSE_DESCRIP: Get a second home. You can access the Tree House catalogue via the Tree House options.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_BIGPOCKET_DESCRIPTION: Reach a coin count of 5000 Panda coins
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_DEVILSSMILE_DESCRIPTION: Go to the Jungle Cave and show the Devil Smiley along with 9 other players AT THE SAME TIME
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_DRESSOMANIA_DESCRIPTION: Change your Panda's complete outfit one hundred times
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_FIRST_MINIGAME_DESCRIPTION: There are many Mini Games on Panfu, go and play at least five of them!
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_FRIENDSHIP_DESCRIPTION: Become friends with five other players.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_GAMBLER_DESCRIPTION: Play 12 different mini games in one day
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_GOLD_STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Become a Gold member and gain access to all the gaming content on Panfu.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_ICECUBE_DESCRIPTION: Dress up as an "Inuit" and transform 5 players into Ice Cubes WITHIN ONE DAY
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL_BOOSTER_DESCRIPTION: In the Jungle Cave, you will find the Booster Cave. There is a platform that only works one day per week. Give it a go until it works!
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_MESSAGE_SENT_DESCRIPTION: Send five messages to your friends.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_MONEYMAKING_DESCRIPTION: Win 1000 Panda coins in a day
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_MOVED_IN_DESCRIPTION: Your Tree House is waiting to be furnished by you. Place three pieces of furniture.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_NINJA_DESCRIPTION: Dress up as a 'ninja' and together with nine other players, make a 'ninja smiley' appear
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_PET_BOLLY_DESCRIPTION: Get a Bolly as a pet. You have to be a Gold Member in order to buy a Bolly.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_PET_POKOPET_DESCRIPTION: Get a sporty Pokopet. You have to be a Gold Member to buy a Pokopet.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_PLAYERCARD_FRIENDS_50_DESCRI: You have at least 50 friends on your Friend List
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_POKOPETROOKIE_DESCRIPTION: Participate in 5 races with your Pokopet
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_PONY_DESCRIPTION: Go to the 'Barn' at the Pony Yard and throw a water bomb at the pony
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_QUEST_CHEF_WOOBY_DESCRIPTION: Complete the quest "The Lost Wooby King".
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_QUEST_ICE_DIAMOND_DESCRIPTIO: Complete the quest "The Magic Ice Diamond".
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_QUEST_MY_SON_PIRATE_DESCRIPT: Complete the Quest "My Son is a Pirate".
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_QUIZ_OSCAR_DESCRIPTION: Visit Oscar at the Beach and win the Bronze Mouse Badge in his internet quiz
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_RARE_MACHINE_DESCRIPTION: In the Jungle, you will find the Jungle Cave. In the entrance area, you will find the Surprise Machine, but it only works once per week. Grab three items out of it!
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SATNIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Meet up with 9 other players at the disco and together with them, dance the 'Disco'
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SCISSORS_DESCRIPTION: Challenge five different players to five rounds of 'Rock, Paper, Scissors'
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SHOPPING_CLOTH_DESCRIPTION: Buy five new items. You will find the catalogue to your top left or at the Gift Shop in the City.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SHOPPING_FURNITURE_DESCRIPTI: Buy a new piece of furniture. You can access the catalogue via your treehouse options.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SHRINKME_DESCRIPTION: Go to Prof. Bookworm's lab and shrink yourself in his Time Machine
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SITIN_DESCRIPTION: Meet 9 other players in the Pirate Bar and sit down together with them
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_SURPRISE_DESCRIPTION: Go to the Castle Tower and throw a Water Balloon at Kamaria
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_TRANSFORMERS_DESCRIPTION: Go to the Eerie Forest and transform into the "Green Cloud" with 9 other players AT THE SAME TIME
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_TREEHOUSE_GUEST_DESCRIPTION: Enter the Treehouse of another player while four other players are in the room.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_TREEHOUSE_HOST_DESCRIPTION: Get four other players to hang with you at your treehouse.
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_WORLD: Around the world in one day
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_WORLD_DESCRIPTION: Visit 30 rooms on Panfu in a day with your favourite Pokopet or Bolly
snippets.ACHIEVEMENT_ZOO_DESCRIPTION: Transform into a 'mouse', while a 'spider' and a 'rabbit' are in the same room
snippets.ACHIEV_TOOLTIP_REWARDS: In order to receive this reward, you will need $$number$$ reward points
snippets.ACHIEV_TOOLTIP_SCORES: For this task, you receive xx points
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_BABY: With the dummy-sucking "Baby Smiley", playing family is even more fun!
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_FROG: Transform other Pandas briefly into a frog!
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_GLOW: Shine brightly in a unique glow!
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_HAUNTED: Your new treehouse - guaranteed to give you goosebumps!
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_HUG: Show your friends how much you like them - with the Huggle Smiley!
snippets.ACH_REW_DESCR_SNAIL: Transform other Pandas briefly into a snail!
snippets.PROGRESS_TRANSFORMERS_B: Transformed into Green Cloud with 9 players
snippets.PROGRESS_WORLD: Progress 'Around the world in one day'
